title: hotfix: SLO enforcer backoff miscalculation causing aggressive load-shedding in regional failover
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Fixes backoff miscalculation in SLO enforcer that caused aggressive load-shedding during cross-region failover. Improves stability and reduces thrashing; no breaking changes.
description:
Context: During a regional failover incident on 2026-02-20 we observed repeated aggressive load-shedding and thrashing across regions. Root cause: the SLO enforcer backoff calculation inadvertently truncated the computed backoff when a downstream circuit-breaker rolled over, resulting in near-zero backoff and repeated re-triggers. This PR patches the backoff math, adds jitter/clamp, and hardens the enforcer state transitions to prefer degraded routing fallback instead of immediate shedding when compatible capacity exists.

What I changed: 1) Fix backoff calculation in backoff_policy.go to use 64-bit math and clamp to configured min/max; include exponential base and jitter. 2) Update enforcer state machine to check regional-compatible model variants before invoking hard load-shedding. 3) Add metrics (slo_enforcer.backoff_ms, slo_enforcer.backoff_count) and tracing hooks for easier post-incident analysis. 4) Add unit and integration tests for edge cases (clock skew, concurrent circuit flips). 5) Add a temporary feature-flagged debug logging path for the next 48h after roll-out.

Testing performed: unit tests (backoff_test) added and passing locally; integration tests simulate regional failover with mock circuits; Canary rollout in staging for 24h showed stable SLOs and reduced shedding events from ~120/min to ~8/min for the repro workload. CI initially failed due to missing import and a test timing assumption; I pushed follow-up commit to fix tests and reran CI.

Checklist:
- [x] Reproduced failure in test harness (ENG-1427)
- [x] Fix implemented and unit tests added
- [x] Integration test for regional failover added
- [x] Metrics added and dashboards updated
- [x] Feature flag added for staged rollout
- [x] Release notes drafted

Rollback plan: revert the merge commit or flip the feature flag (feature-flag name: slo_enforcer_backoff_fix) to disable the new backoff behavior. If revert necessary, we will also rollback the metrics dashboard change.

Related: ENG-1427, SRE-89, SUP-3041. This is a hotfix intended for immediate merge to main and cherry-pick to current release branch if needed.
